purpose: Execute the atomic create-reference-frame operation within the MA-01 boundary: One geometry-reference frame only. The current variant does not create or attach a persistent CoordinateSystem and is not a component/occurrence operation.
trigger: Use when the build plan requires create-reference-frame and all declared inputs have been resolved for the current SpaceClaim V21 action boundary.

inputs.name: origin_mm
inputs.description: Frame origin in millimetres; each value must be finite.

inputs.name: x_axis
inputs.description: Finite nonzero X-axis direction components; the helper normalizes the direction.

inputs.name: y_axis
inputs.description: Finite nonzero Y-axis direction components; must be orthogonal to x_axis.

preconditions: origin_mm, x_axis, and y_axis are three-element finite numeric vectors.
Both axes are nonzero and their normalized dot product is within 1e-9 of zero.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: An in-memory frame reference returned by Frame.Create; no document datum is created.

postconditions: The operation returns Frame.Create(point_mm(origin_mm), direction(x_axis), direction(y_axis)) without an exception.

implementation.notes: Execute the atomic create-reference-frame operation within the MA-01 boundary: One geometry-reference frame only.
